technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot for rapid configuration and integration with Docker and external services.
Leverage Spring Cloud for service discovery mechanisms (e.g., Consul, Eureka).
Implement CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins or GitHub Actions for Docker image builds.
Use YAML-based configuration files (e.g., servers.yml) for centralized property management.
Integrate with HDFS using Spring Data and Hadoop components.
Use Mesos and Marathon APIs for cluster deployment orchestration.
Apply modular design principles to support pluggable data partitioning strategies.
assumptions: Developers are already familiar with Spring Boot and Docker.
Existing CI infrastructure is available for Docker image builds.
External services (Rabbit, Redis, etc.) are accessible and documented.
Mesos and Marathon environments are pre-configured for testing.
Spring Boot version upgrades will be evaluated against current project dependencies.
Documentation templates and standards are already defined.
All required external libraries and tools are available in the development environment.

activities.activity_description: Implement configuration options to link Docker XD containers to external services like Rabbit, Redis, Zookeeper, Hadoop, and Mongo, including binding attributes and environment variables.
Add support for configuring Docker XD containers using service discovery tools to manage inter-service communication in a cluster.

activities.activity_name: CI Build for Docker Image Creation
activities.activity_description: Set up CI pipeline to build Docker images containing all components and configurations, enabling testing and deployment across environments.
Create documentation outlining recommendations for deploying an XD cluster using Apache Mesos with the Marathon framework.
Assess impact of upgrading Spring Boot dependencies to ensure no side effects or regressions in existing functionality.
Provide option to define custom data partitioning strategies to parallelize data ingestion from RDBMS to HDFS.
Develop an HDFS source module to allow direct ingestion of data from the Hadoop Distributed File System.
Enable overriding the default commit-interval property in servers.yml for all out-of-the-box jobs that support partitioning.
